items.title: Lars Edegran Interview, 1965-09-27
items.q: I met an old New Orleans musician... who told me... that he played with Ferri Kepa.

ctx.x: I mean New Orleans style bands.

Well, traditional jazz I would say. I heard, it was very funny because about two years ago when I was in Paris, it was stupid for me not to pick up the name. I met an old New Orleans musician, saxophone player and piano player, who told me, which I don't know it's true, that he played with Ferri Kepa. He was very old and invasive maybe, right? I sat in with the band he was playing. He was playing with the French band. He was working there with the French band.
